title: ImageDescriptionExtractorLLMOutput
description: LLM output schema for ImageExtractor description generation

description.description: Natural language description of the image (2-5 sentences)

drawio_description.description: Draw.io-style structured description for structural diagrams (empty string for non-structural)

has_structural_content.description: True if image contains structural content (UML, ER, architecture, flowchart)
